newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste sees full-yr profit after 8-mth loss.
newsitem.headline: Neste sees full-yr profit after 8-mth loss.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said on Friday it expected a clearly smaller full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax than last year.

"We can anticipate that Neste's performance during the last four months of the year will improve, and that the group's overall result before extraordinary items for 1996 will be profitable, albeit substantially poorer than in 1995," Neste said in a statement with its January-August results.
In 1995, Neste's profit before extras and tax was 1.36 billion markka.
In January-August, Neste plunged to a 26 million markka loss before extras and tax from a 1.14 billion markka profit in the year-ago period.
Neste said its oil division had incurred an 81 million markka operating loss.

"The loss for the oil division includes a sales margin deficit of 495 million markka posted by Neste's crude oil trading. This sum includes losses realised by the end of the review period as well as potential losses on commitments due within the next 12 months market-to-market at the time the interim report was being prepared," Neste said.
The development of crude oil prices would affect profitability, the company said.

"Economic conditions in the petrochemicals industry which are difficult to forecast and characterised by rapid fluctuations will have a material impact on Neste's profit through the associated company Borealis," Neste said.
"Volatility in the crude oil price will also have a direct impact on Neste's refining profit," it added.
The forecast for a full-year profit was built on the assumption that "market prices remain fairly stable," it said.
